name: path
title: world.path
lead: The points a body walks from `from` to the block at `to`, or nil. The game's own search: a step up of one block, falls of `fall` (3). `size` is { width, height } (0.6, 1.8); `swim` goes through water; `range` (the distance + 16) and `budget` (2000 nodes) stop a long search, which then gives the part that came closest.
signature: world.path(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, opts: { size: (number | { number })?, swim: boolean ?, fall: number ?, range: number ?, budget: number ? }?) → { Vec3 }?
